subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about qualified leads for your portal. With the prime rate easing, first-time buyer applications hit 46.3 percent in Q4 2025 and bond volumes rose 9 percent year on year (ooba.co.za), so fresh demand is landing on listings as Private Property pushes paid acquisition. Lead costs here average around R550 and swing from R290 to R770 (superads.ai), so screening and incrementality decide your real cost per validated enquiry. We hold out a control group so paid leads read as incremental to organic house-hunters. Worth a quick compare?
angle: fresh angle: 2026 SA rate-cut buyer-demand surge (sourced) + real-estate lead-cost band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN real_estate_proptech: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior; fresh angle = timely SA development (2026 rate cuts, 46.3 percent first-time buyer applications Q4'25, bond volumes +9 percent YoY, ooba.co.za) plus real-estate lead-cost band (~$30 / approx R550, R290-R770 from superads.ai, ZAR-converted); names Private Property from brand_candidates (rotated for stage 2), no cross_border rival; MobUpps holdout reference carries no figure; market context REAL and web-verified with URLs; 1 question mark; native SA English; no sign-off; X-not-Y avoided.
